[[File:Bardottan_meditation.png|thumb|250px|Queen Julia and Jar Jar Binks meditate]]
A system of '''meditative exercises''' was practiced by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] that hailed from [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]], around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Julia/Legends|Julia]] and the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] at one point practiced this form of [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] in order to discover the truth behind the disappearance of the [[Dagoyan Masters/Legends|Dagoyan Masters]]. With the meditation, the monarch was able to learn of the kidnapping plot, but was kipnapped herself before she could reveal it to Binks.<ref name="epguide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep608|text="The Disappeared, Part I" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Episode Gallery, slides 10 and 12}}</ref>
